server.name: kesher-relationship-tools
server.instructions: Use these read-only tools only for structured Hebrew couple-communication support. Never use them for crisis or violence, self-harm, legal or divorce advice, medical or sexual-health advice, diagnosis, surveillance, coercion, manipulation, or generic relationship information. Do not send raw chat transcripts or personal identifiers.

tools.name: get_conflict_pattern
tools.title: Understand a recurring couple-conflict pattern
tools.description: Use this when a Hebrew-speaking user wants a structured, non-diagnostic explanation of a recurring couple-communication pattern after the situation has been reduced to structured interaction signals. Do not use for crisis or violence, self-harm, legal or divorce advice, medical or sexual-health advice, diagnosis, surveillance, coercion or manipulation, generic relationship information, or romantic writing.

locale.description: Fixed locale for the V1 Hebrew experience.

topic.description: The broad subject of the recurring disagreement, without names or identifying details.

signals.description: Observed interaction signals only; do not infer diagnoses, motives, or personality traits.

goal.description: What the user wants from the structured pattern explanation.

explanation.description: A concise, non-diagnostic explanation of the interaction pattern.

observations.description: Neutral observations about the interaction, not labels applied to a person.

next_step.description: One concrete, low-risk next step for a calmer conversation.

resource_tags.description: Bounded tags for later matching against Kesher-owned resources.

tools.name: get_conversation_plan
tools.title: Plan a difficult couple conversation
tools.description: Use this when a Hebrew-speaking user wants a short, structured plan for starting or repairing a difficult couple conversation using a known topic, goal, emotional level, and communication style. Do not use for crisis or violence, self-harm, legal or divorce advice, medical or sexual-health advice, diagnosis, surveillance, coercion or manipulation, generic relationship information, or romantic writing.

locale.description: Fixed locale for the V1 Hebrew experience.

topic.description: The broad conversation topic, without names or identifying details.

goal.description: The practical conversational outcome the user wants.

emotional_level.description: Current emotional intensity as reported or inferred only from the present request; not a clinical assessment.

style.description: Preferred communication style for the suggested wording.

constraints.description: Optional bounded preferences; never include free-form private details.

opening.description: A concise Hebrew opening phrase that avoids diagnosis, threats, or blame.

steps.description: A short sequence for the conversation.

phrases_to_avoid.description: Examples of escalation-prone wording to avoid.

repair_phrase.description: A neutral phrase for repairing the conversation if tension rises.

pause_plan.description: A non-abandoning way to pause and return to the conversation if needed.

resource_tags.description: Bounded tags for later matching against Kesher-owned resources.
